label: Raskys
headline: Not just somewhere to *drink*.
description: Raskys is the venue I want to open: cocktails, wine, live music and the kind of service that makes people feel remembered. It doesn't exist yet. The plan does.

blueprintImage.alt: Light architectural blueprint for the Raskys venue concept

pageHeadline: A future venue brand with soul.
pageDescription: A flexible hospitality concept for the right coastal or high-footfall location: premium restaurant energy, quality drinks, live music, events, warm service, rooftop atmosphere and memorable moments.

concepts.title: Quality drinks
concepts.description: Seasonal menus, signature cocktails, good wine and a clear point of view.

concepts.title: Live music & events
concepts.description: Bands, DJ sets, tastings and community nights: reasons to come back.

concepts.title: Warm service
concepts.description: Staff who know the menu, remember faces and get the timing right.

concepts.title: A brand that travels
concepts.description: Built to work in the right location, not just one street.

vision.title: Where it could go
vision.description: A larger venue with a restaurant, several bars, live stages, a rooftop, boutique bowling, casino-style games and space for private events.
vision.quote: "Great venues are not just built. They're felt."
